security.finding: P2 decoded-plan allowlist accepted Object.prototype inherited property names through secretSettings[source]. This is a configuration preflight bypass, not a default-template exploit or a remote application vulnerability.
security.before: Independent unchanged adversarial probe accepted constructor, toString and __proto__.
security.fix: Require string source and Object.hasOwn(secretSettings, source); existing three named identities and relative/exact absolute target constraints remain enforced.

independentExecution.prototypeProbe: All three formerly accepted inputs rejected

security.disposition: Finding resolved; source/local policy review accepted. Actual Docker Compose, TLS and complete exact-head CI remain separate gates.

vibeNativeApiFollowup.scope: New fifth pipeline case connects actual Nest API, PostgreSQL, VibeRunner and go-judge. Only paid AI evaluation is replaced with unavailable mock. Public run, final hidden scoring, revision persistence and version binding are asserted.
vibeNativeApiFollowup.independentExecution: npm run typecheck passed in own detached worktree.
vibeNativeApiFollowup.disposition: Static pipeline test and typecheck accepted. Native runtime execution requires fresh CI; local full-API author timeout reports are not represented as green.

database.scope: Statement deltas, distinct-solver multiplicities, ordered problem-stat locking, FK lock edges, all verdict/test/key transitions, migration reconciliation and transaction rollback, finite benchmark safety and same-work definitions.
extraProbes: First-ever statistics row contention with initial writer commit and rollback
Atomic verdict-write failure and full rollback when multiplicity is deliberately corrupted
database.reviewerFixtureCorrection: First additional-probe setup failed because reviewer-generated UUID username exceeded existing varchar(30); fixture shortened only. Repository 11 tests already passed in that run. Original failure log retained.
database.sourceDisposition: No blocking source finding at reviewed HEAD. New FK points at already locked problem_stats; legacy stats repair precedes counter backfill. No API contract change.
limitations: Not an online production migration: submission/stat writers are locked during rebuild.
Ordered targets apply within one statement; this does not prove arbitrary multi-statement transactions cannot deadlock.
Large source-code transition-table memory/spill and long sustained workloads remain unmeasured.
Benchmark numbers were not yet available at this review; final exact-head CI and final matching-source benchmark are required.

benchmarkFollowup.verdict: Same-source bounded SQL write-path benchmark is internally consistent. Fresh final CI remains required.
benchmarkFollowup.reportedTradeoffs: At 50,000 historical rows, four-client completion p95 343.766ms to 5.715ms. Heartbeat p95 increased 0.740ms to 1.213ms; at 1,000 history rows serial completion p95 increased 1.418ms to 1.509ms.
benchmarkFollowup.tailCaution: Bulk has only fourteen samples per mode; nearest-rank p95 and p99 are both the observed maximum, not a stable production tail estimate.
benchmarkFollowup.executionBoundary: Reviewer recomputed the author raw artifact and compared source hashes to git objects; reviewer did not run a second benchmark.

resourceBoundary: No production resources, repository-author files, remote GitHub state or paid provider calls changed. Only own detached review worktrees and disposable local services were used.
